categories.items: 0..10; sorted by id_order; unique id; zero entries omitted

invariants: same object is carried unchanged by both provider send ingress surfaces
internal_carrier.wire_exclusion: excluded from provider request bytes, ProviderWireEnvelope, authority digest, catalog digest, and request digest; cannot alter provider behavior

physical_call_identity.after_send_before_cas: recovery reuses the exact durable subject, fallback parent, route digest, and deterministic physical ordinal
physical_call_identity.callback_context: before-send, after-send, and receipt callbacks receive one immutable ProviderPhysicalSendContext
physical_call_identity.identity_route: existing generic provider endpoint semantics remain unchanged
physical_call_identity.kernel_attempt_telemetry: max(legacy attempt count, deterministic physical ordinal); telemetry never defines durable identity

physical_ordinal.openai_previous_response_fallback: primary ordinal 0 maps to fallback physical ordinal 1
physical_ordinal.primary: route-local retry ordinal n maps to physical ordinal n
physical_ordinal.primary_retry_gt_0_to_fallback: unsupported and fail closed; separate P1 authorization required

physical_call_identity.wire_evidence: wire.route_name is exact ProviderRequestSubject.route; wire.route_sha256 is exact ProviderWireRoute digest

privacy.allowlisted_digests: call-local envelope and route digests only; never UI content or a cross-user index

receipt_extension.attributed_tokens: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991; bool forbidden; equals sum(categories[*].tokens)

categories.items: 0..10; sorted by id_order; unique id; zero entries omitted
categories.subtypes: exactly []; non-empty is unsupported-version/invalid in V1

receipt_extension.context_window_tokens: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991 or null; bool forbidden
quality_invariants: reconciled_estimate requires coverage.status=reconciled, non-null residual_tokens, reported receipt input total, and attributed_tokens + residual_tokens == receipt.usage.input.total_tokens
partial requires coverage.status=unreconciled, residual_tokens=null, and incomplete source or wire coverage
attributed overestimate preserves category estimates and uses estimated or partial with null residual; no clamp, proportional scaling, residual zero, equality, or percentage claim
provider input total remains only in receipt.usage.input.total_tokens and is never copied into this extension
receipt_extension.residual_tokens: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991 or null; bool forbidden

wire.context_mode: bounded NFC runtime closed enum from authoritative ProviderWireEnvelope

receipt_failure_boundary.base_receipt: composition enrichment may degrade only after a valid base receipt has been constructed
receipt_failure_boundary.composition_failure: omit or reject the composition extension with a stable availability reason while preserving the provider call and valid base receipt

run_bundle_carriage.integrity: receipt extension is covered by immutable receipt hash; receipt-set carriage is covered by RunBundle digest

runtime_features.admission: composition_availability_only; MUST NOT enter global _REQUIRED_PROTOCOLS or block ordinary V4/provider send, tools, interactions, or base RunBundle creation
runtime_features.missing_behavior: Context Composition unavailable with stable reason; breakdown hidden or disabled; existing receipts and bundles remain valid
